title: Metabolomic Analysis of Polyamines
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Sample preparation - biological fluids and tissue

steps.title: Extract Metabolites from Samples
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites from various sample types using ice-cold 6% TCA extraction buffer containing labeled internal standards (13C5 ornithine Cat# CLM-4724-H-PK, 13C4 putrescine Cat# CLM-6574-PK, 13C4 spermidine Cat# CLM-9435-PK, and D8 spermine Cat# DLM-9262-PK).

substeps.instruction: For cells: Wash cells with 0.9% NaCl.
For ACM or plasma: Mix 50 µL of sample with 50 µL of ice-cold TCA extraction buffer containing internal standards.

For cerebrospinal fluid (CSF): Combine each sample with an equal volume of ice-cold 6% TCA extraction buffer containing internal standards. Pool samples across animals of the same genotype and sex if necessary.
For cortical brain tissue (15–30 mg): Add 250 µL of ice-cold TCA extraction buffer containing internal standards and homogenize in Ribolyser tubes.
For general cell extraction: Add 150 µL of ice-cold 6% TCA to extract metabolites.

steps.title: Process Cell Lysates
steps.instruction: Collect and process cell lysates for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Collect lysate with a cell scraper and incubate on ice for 00:30:00.
Centrifuge lysate at 20000 x g, 4 °C, for 20 minutes.
Collect the supernatant, flash-freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80 °C.
Add 25 µL of isobutyl chloroformate and incubate at 35 °C for 00:30:00.
Alternatively, for specific samples: Add 10 µL of isobutyl chloroformate and 360 µL of sodium carbonate buffer, then incubate at 35 °C for 00:30:00.
Centrifuge and collect 40 µL of supernatant for derivatization.

steps.title: Phase Separation and Purification
steps.instruction: Separate phases and prepare the sample for LC-MS.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of diethyl ether, vortex, and incubate for 00:15:00 at 25 °C.
Transfer 800 µL of the reaction mixture to a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 900 µL of sodium carbonate buffer to 100 µL of supernatant.
Collect 900 µL of the upper phase, dry under vacuum, and dissolve in 125 µL of 50% acetonitrile in water with 0.1% formic acid.
Transfer to an MS vial.

steps.title: LC-MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze samples using LC-MS with the specified parameters.

substeps.instruction: Set mass spectrometer to full scan (70–750 m/z), positive mode.
Use solvent A (H2O with 0.2% acetic acid) and solvent B (acetonitrile with 0.2% acetic acid).
Load 10 µL onto the LC system with an ACQUITY UPLC HSS C18 column.
Maintain flow rate at 250 μL/min and column temperature at 30 °C.
Apply gradient: 0–2 min: 20% B; 2–10 min: Linear increase to 85% B; 10–17 min: Hold at 85% B; 18 min: Return to 20% B.

steps.title: Alternative HPLC Gradient Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform analysis using the alternative HPLC gradient and pre-column.

substeps.instruction: Load 50 µL onto the LC system with a VanGuard Pre-column.
Transfer to an MS vial.

Program HPLC gradient: 0–0.67 min: 5% B, flow rate 1.8 mL/min to waste; 0.67–1 min: 5–35% B; 1–1.1 min: Flow reduced to 0.3 mL/min, increase to 36% B; 1.1–3 min: Linear increase to 85% B, hold until 4.7 min; 4.7–4.73 min: Redirect flow to waste, decrease flow to 1.8 mL/min; 4.73–4.86 min: Decrease to 5% B, equilibrate.
